scope: Raw unified=4 diffs in eight named core files. Indexed hunks are not reviewed hunks. Other core/optimizer files remain outside this ledger.

reference-dispatch.disposition: Partly unresolved: ASSIGN and ASSIGN_REF dispatch now reaches write compilation; temporary-producing writes can lint yet emit invalid opcodes. Do not equate this with a valid-language relaxation.

list-and-assignment.disposition: Result kinds, dereference operations, statement result elision, and nested assignments reviewed. Reference-list controls retain lint outcomes. Dimension-write validity is unresolved.

reference-return-yield.disposition: Variable-or-call classification now checks nullsafe call reference returns/yields. Finally/constructor warnings preserve acceptance. Folded closure differs from dead if/unreachable statements.

pipe.disposition: PFA partial application and result context propagation; paired pipe-reference syntax accepted by both. Wider optimized-call paths remain unreviewed.

constant-pfa.disposition: Initializer traversal visits FCC/PFA arguments before folding. Placeholder ordering is contextual; ordinary discarded PFA can avoid checks. Explicit static requirement for constant closures remains.

closure-cache.disposition: Cache is conditional on explicitly static closure without static variables, inside a declaring function. It does not implement automatic static inference.
closure-cache.remaining: Finish exact cache/optimized-call upstream test mapping.

mechanical.reason: All changed C tokens match after removing const qualification and mapping true/false to 1/0; string/character literals and comments are retained as tokens, preprocessing edits excluded. No branch, call, operand or diagnostic change.
mechanical.method: Exact restricted token equivalence, not broad type-spelling or arbitrary whitespace normalization.

printf-traversal.reason: Direct source review plus paired probes establish PHP86-015.

call-reference-contexts.reason: Direct review of R/IS TMP conversion and preserved write VAR paths. Related foreach and PFA optimized-call probes pass controls; does not settle all optimized-call interactions.

pfa-ast.reason: Placeholder detection wraps general argument lists in FCC AST nodes; evaluator walks bound arguments and enforces reference restrictions during evaluation; AST apply now visits FCC arguments. Matches PHP86-001/002; full validation-stage coverage remains required.

inheritance-order.reason: Parent interface inheritance moved before constant/method/property checks. Actual order change; no safe no-impact conclusion without subtype/linking regression reconciliation.

override-constants.reason: Matching nonprivate inherited constants clear Override; unmatched flags rejected. Prior declaration-link probes cover parent/interface, missing/private targets.

enum-debug.reason: Only debugInfo prohibition removed; other disallowed method macros remain, including __get despite misleading comment. Prior declaration-link controls confirm distinction.

phase22.scopeLimit: Eight-file raw ledger only. Risk defaults are conservative triage, not semantic conclusions. Optimizer/core files outside this ledger retain PHP86-013 review obligations. Phase 2.1 fields preserved.

phase3d.note: Additive review overlay; phase22 risk/disposition counts remain historical. Review is not automatic resolution.
